camera.name: Optical Camera
camera.description: Takes visible-light photographs of the planet or stars.
camera.why: The workhorse imager. Good for general imaging and change detection.

multispectral.name: Multispectral Imager
multispectral.description: Images in multiple wavelength bands (e.g., near-infrared) to tell vegetation from water.
multispectral.why: Sees more than the human eye. Key for climate and land-cover science.

radar.name: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR)
radar.description: Radar that penetrates clouds and works at night.
radar.why: All-weather imaging, but heavy, power-hungry, and produces lots of data.

spectrometer.name: Spectrometer
spectrometer.description: Measures light intensity by wavelength to identify gases and minerals.
spectrometer.why: How we detect CO2, methane, and surface minerals.

magnetometer.name: Magnetometer
magnetometer.description: Measures magnetic fields around a planet or moon.
magnetometer.why: Light and cheap, but only useful for magnetism science.

ir.name: Infrared Detector
ir.description: Sees heat. Needs a cryocooler, which consumes extra power.
ir.why: Great for wildfire hotspots and water ice, but needs cooling.

uv.name: UV Detector
uv.description: Observes ultraviolet light from hot stars and young galaxies.
uv.why: Blocked by Earth's atmosphere, so it must go to space.

xray.name: X-ray Detector
xray.description: Images X-rays from black holes and supernova remnants.
xray.why: Very heavy and needs shielding; only for X-ray science.

lidar.name: Laser Altimeter (LIDAR)
lidar.description: Fires laser pulses to measure surface height precisely.
lidar.why: Makes topographic maps and measures ice-sheet height.

gamma.name: Gamma-Ray Spectrometer
gamma.description: Maps elemental composition by detecting gamma rays from the surface.
gamma.why: Good for finding water and minerals on airless bodies.

magmeter.name: Fluxgate Magnetometer
magmeter.why: Tiny and cheap; good for beginner magnetic surveys.

auroraCam.name: Aurora / Airglow Camera
auroraCam.description: Implements night-side aurora and atmospheric emission imaging.
